name: Medallion Financial Corp.
summary: Medallion Financial Corp., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a specialty finance company in the United States. It operates through four segments: Recreation Lending, Home Improvement Lending, Commercial Loans, and Taxi Medallion Lending.
